Title: Rishabh's Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Kavita - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rishabh bursts out laughing.]

Rishabh: "And then?"

[Rishabh starts crying.]

Kavita: "Well done!"

[Rishabh smiles at Mother.]

Kavita: "I'm ready!"

[Rishabh stamps his foot in anger.]

Kavita: "Show me too!"

[Rishabh gets frightened and steps back.]

Kavita: "I really enjoyed today."
